items.t: Supports establishing a state lottery in Alabama.
items.q: He said it is time for Alabama to join most states in establishing a state lottery and expanding Medicaid.

items.t: Voted for the Republican budget deal in January 2018, one of five Democrats to do so.
items.q: He was one of five Democrats to vote for the Republican budget deal in January 2018

items.t: Introduced the Trade Security Act, with Senators Rob Portman and Joni Ernst, to reform Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962 and require the Department of Defense to justify the national security basis for new tariffs under Section 232.
items.q: U.S. Senators Rob Portman (R-OH), Doug Jones (D-AL), and Joni Ernst (R-IA) today introduced the Trade Security Act, legislation that will reform Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962

items.t: Supports keeping the Hyde Amendment language in the Affordable Care Act stabilization bill.
items.q: Jones supports leaving Hyde Amendment in the stabilization bill: Sen. Doug Jones, D-Ala., said at the “Examining Healthcare” event that he would have voted in favor of the Affordable Care Act stabilization bill even with the Hyde Amendment language attached

items.t: Voted no on a cloture vote on S.J.R. 9, the joint resolution recognizing the duty of the Federal Government to create a Green New Deal.
items.q: Four Democratic caucus members—Sens. Doug Jones (Ala.), Angus King (I., Maine), Joe Manchin (W.Va.), and Kyrsten Sinema (Ariz.)—voted "no.

items.t: Introduced the American Broadband Buildout Act of 2019 with Senator Susan Collins, a bill directing the FCC to provide up to $5 billion in matching grants to help states improve broadband infrastructure (2019).
items.q: introduced the American Broadband Buildout Act of 2019 (ABBA), a bipartisan bill to ensure that rural Americans have access to broadband services at speeds they need to fully participate in the modern society and economy by directing the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) to provide up to $5 billion in matching grants to help states improve broadband infrastructure.

items.t: Co-sponsored the Transporting Livestock Across America Safely Act (2019).
